name: code4me-ntg
description: Lightweight milestone orchestration with cross-vendor validation, resumable handovers, and optional Trello task synchronization.

interface.longDescription: Code4Me coordinates lightweight milestones through task-scoped teams, chooses model tier and effort per role, carries project and task-matched guidance, enforces cross-room worker contracts and independent validation, preserves compact resumable handovers, shares durable Basic Memory context, synchronizes optional Trello task boards, and synthesizes blind cross-vendor code audits without applying fixes.
